title: Almost no real actors in their movies
body: Although some of their older movies were truly good, these days in almost every movie the actors look like they were created by AI and it is just creepy as hell!!!!! I am fine with real anime where the art has been infused with interesting expressions and characteristics by human artists, but the stuff AI creates has a soulless quality that is so marginally human that it misses in a way that is chilling and creepy so I can’t stand it. The worst part is that with tiny thumbnails it’s almost impossible to search out the rare movie that has real actors, and I hate having to watch an opening scene of each ghastly AI-acted film before I close it!!!!! Because my membership still runs for a half year I keep coming back looking for new films in hopes of the return of more good movies like some of their past accomplishments with real actors, which were marvelous!!! But anything real is more and more rare! Go sign up for RealShort or DramaBox or CandyJarTV if you want to experience the artistic skills of real actors!
